Name: Stardew ATV
Author: robertsvalley
Description:
[b]Updated added HORN "H" or Left-Stick Click -sound is my son's tuba. replace the  horn1.ogg in the mod file if you want different sounds. (export your ogg as mono/44.100 kHz)

Ever wanted a 4-wheeler ATV to get around faster like some real life farms?


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39742/39742-1764649010-1786223886.gif[/img]

[/b][b]It's a faster way to get around with some game balance to hopefully not make it overpowered. i.e. gas requirement and damage.
No garage required. The ATV spawns near the mailbox.  Moves the speed of the standard horse.[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39742/39742-1764649024-40436712.gif[/img]


How to get started with ATV:
1. Hop on and ram some things.
2. Buy gas from Pierre's secret stash (normal shop inventory).
3. Buy parts to fix it from Clint the blacksmith.
4. save up 200,000 gil and buy Clint's secret turbo motor (normal shop inventory).

Road Map:
Horn!
Jump off porch and mount
Bio gas using Bio-digester from my other mod (not implemented yet).
